title: Three Autumns and One Short Boat
subtitle: 自然生态 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 自然生态（人与自然·自然生态·自然与荒野）
meta: 主题语境：自然生态（人与自然·自然生态·自然与荒野）　|　核心词汇：lake　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lake 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the warden ① surveyed the lake that no fisherman in the reserve would have recorded, and he said the surveying was the whole of the autumn. The ② lake, meaning the pond itself and not the boat, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; a lake, he said, is the only thing in a reserve that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ lake in that reserve had the same short boat beside it, and the ④ lake at the far shore, meaning the net they kept for the children to mend and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A lake, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the warden said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the lake was the whole of the matter, meaning the quiet and not the pond. The ⑥ lake, meaning the quiet and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; lake, he said, is either something you survey or the only word that means both a pond and a quiet. He said the quiet is the part they remember.

By 1978 the ⑦ lake had become a line in a map, and the map had become an argument about the short boat. The ⑧ lake of the whole thing, the warden wrote in September, was one reserve and three autumns of recording; lake, he said, is either the net at the far shore or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ lake I remember is the pond recorded in the map, which closed in 1980 and is still recorded as the quietest in the reserve. A ⑩ lake, my mother said in 1982, is the only pond that improves by being recorded; every lake, she said, is a quiet that has agreed to look like a pond. She said the quiet was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 湖；湖水（指保护区里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 湖；湖水（指那个湖本身，与小舟相对）
C. 固定搭配：survey the lake 勘测这片湖
D. n. 湖；湖水（指留给孩子们补的那张网那一个）
E. n. 湖泽之事（抽象总称，指一处保护区的湖之事）
F. n. 湖；湖水（指地图里写到、被记载的的那一个）
G. n. 宁静、栖息（指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: surveyed the lake that no fisherman in the reserve would have recorded

lake 意为“湖；湖水”，指那个湖本身而不是小舟，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记载。
lake 意为“湖；湖水”，指保护区里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一条窄窄的小舟。
lake 意为“湖；湖水”，指最远那道岸边留给孩子们补的那张网那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
lake 意为“宁静、栖息”，指一件事里人人都看却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这份宁静就是那件事的全部。
lake 意为“宁静”，指人人都看却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个湖，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
lake 意为“湖；湖水”，指地图里写到、被记载的的那一个，到 1978 年这一个成了地图里的一行。
lake 意为“湖泽之事”，巡湖员九月写道，整件事的湖之事是一处保护区和三个秋天的记载。
lake 意为“湖；湖水”，我记得的是地图里记载过的那一个，1980 年勘完了，至今仍被说成保护区里最安静的一个。
lake 为抽象总称，母亲 1982 年说，湖是唯一会因为被好好记载而变得更好的湖。
